Absolutely Stunning Masala Dosa and Channa Massala!!!
Aug 2025 • Solo
I have eaten a million masala dosa on my masala dosa quest and I have to say the sauces on Anam’s dosa are exquisite! Not only is the masala dosa stunning (and yes they only serve them in the evenings - like a lot of places- but very kindly made me a special request after seeing how much I desired a masala dosa today! The chutney was sublime and I was so excited by the food that I ordered a second meal; Channa Massala!!! Super yummy with brilliant spicing and lovely roti to sop it up with! Full tim and fill of happiness! Thank you so much! Spent days looking for a masala dosa in Hanoi that hadn’t closed down or lived! It was all worth it and my 30 minute taxi journey just to eat these gorgeous Indian delights! Thank you so much guys ✨✨✨☀️

Delectable delight 😊
Jan 2025 • Family
Annam Restaurant in Hanoi offers a delightful South Indian dining experience right in the heart of the city, close to the Old Quarter. Situated on the 4th floor, accessible by lift, this cozy spot serves up a hearty, authentic South Indian meal. We had a full spread, including crispy idlis, dosa, and a rich ghee roast that truly hit the spot.

The food is flavorful, well-prepared, and a welcome change for anyone craving Indian cuisine in Hanoi. The owner, who speaks Hindi, adds a personal touch to the experience, making it feel even more homely. The ambiance is simple yet comfortable, perfect for a casual meal.

If you're in the area and looking for a taste of South India, Annam is definitely worth a visit!

Best palce for South Indian food in Hanoi

One of the best place to eat authentic South Indian food in Hanoi.

This si not a very gancy hotel but the south indian food is simply superb !!

We went twice top tghis restaurant & both times we had south indian dishes only.

We ordered paepr dosa, masala dosa, mysore dosa, tomato onion utappam, rasm vad( not very apeealing), samabar rice, lemeon rice & buttermilk.

The dosas were simply awesome so was the chutneys & sambar.

We did not order north indian food but when we saw on others table it did not look very appealing.
